integrity: The general statement is proved by explicit elementary collapses, edge-uniqueness, connectivity, and graph-cycle-rank calculations. The literature comparison distinguishes this direct collapse from broader homotopy-type results.
scientific_limitations: The proof requires a finite connected simple bipartite graph with no 4-cycle. The explicit spine depends on root choices. Finite verification through six vertices and three projective-plane incidence graphs supplements but does not replace the general proof.
title: Explicit graph-spine collapses for square-free bipartite neighborhood complexes
